name: Persephone's Descent
source:
Persephone's Descent is a Horror Game based loosely on the myth of Hades and Persephone.  You play as Persephone, a young spring goddess who enjoys a quiet life with her mother on their farm. But things change when you tend to your flowers one day and see a strange person covered in blood following you.

How will you react? That's up to you...

[From [url=https://tinyclowngames.itch.io/persephones-descent-beta]Itch.io[/url]]
